values.note: Free first-come developed-dispersed camping. Camping only at campsites designated by a campsite sign; no more than two vehicles per campsite. Monongahela limit: 14 cumulative days at one site within 28 days.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/alerts/gandy-creek-dispersed-area (Order 21-87: prohibited within the Gandy Creek Dispersed Camping area along State Route 29: 'Camping, except at campsites designated by a campsite sign', 'Possessing, parking or leaving more than two vehicles ... per campsite') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/alerts/general-use-restrictions ('Camping outside developed campgrounds at any one campsite in excess of fourteen (14) cumulative days within a 28-day period') + Monongahela NF release reprinted by Parsons Advocate 2023-04-24 ('developed-dispersed campsites available free of charge'; lists 'Gandy Creek Dispersed Camping (County Route 29)' under the Cheat-Potomac Ranger District), read 2026-10-21

values.note: The area's vault toilet has been closed since August 11, 2026 after a fallen tree struck it; the Forest Service says it cannot be repaired and must be fully replaced.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/alerts/gandy-creek-dispersed-area-vault-toilet-temporarily-closed ('The vault toilet unit at the Gandy Creek Dispersed Area is closed due to structural damage ... requires a full replacement', alert start August 11, 2026, end October 30, 2026), read 2026-10-21

summary: Forest Service designated (signed) developed-dispersed sites on the Cheat-Potomac Ranger District along CR 29: confirmed free, first-come, not reservable; added a 14-day limit, the signed-site and two-vehicle rules, and the (currently closed) vault toilet. No FS statement on road conditions or 4WD. Not stated: site count, rig size, season. Note left as is.
flags: Aggregator links in website: thedyrt.com (and a purplelizard.com blog post). There is no Forest Service recreation page for the area; the agency pages are the Gandy Creek forest order https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/alerts/gandy-creek-dispersed-area and the toilet alert https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/alerts/gandy-creek-dispersed-area-vault-toilet-temporarily-closed.
Missing phone: Cheat-Potomac Ranger District (304) 257-4488 (Monongahela release; the toilet alert gives the same number for the Potomac Ranger District).
Criteria (unconfirmed): no Forest Service page says what size rig the signed sites take; AWH's note counts about three RV sites.
